name: shoot.remove_idea
description: Takes an idea off this shoot. On the shoot's own page the shoot stays even when empty; leaving from the idea's page (`leave`), a planned shoot left empty goes.
sql:
with dropped as (
  delete from brandbase.shoots s
  where coalesce(:leave::boolean, false) and s.brand_id = :brand and s.origin = 'planned'
    and cardinality(case when s.id = :id then array_remove(s.idea_ids, :ideaId) else s.idea_ids end) = 0
  returning s.id
),
kept as (
  update brandbase.shoots s set idea_ids = array_remove(s.idea_ids, :ideaId), version = s.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  where s.id = :id and s.brand_id = :brand and s.id not in (select id from dropped)
  returning s.*
)
select brandbase.shoot_json(to_jsonb(k), coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) from brandbase.crew c where c.shoot_id = k.id), '[]')) as result from kept k
union all
select jsonb_build_object('deleted', d.id) from dropped d where d.id = :id
